complete_examples.text: However, due to the poor consistency in initial contact states between sleepers and ballast, this paper considers the sleeper-ballast contact status as changes in friction coefficient.
Specifically, the friction coefficient between the ballast particles and the sleeper is set at 0.5, and the friction coefficient between the ballast and the wall units is also 0.5.
